title: “We Made Progress on the USMCA Review”: President Sheinbaum Upon Concluding Meeting With Greer
author: Alma E. Muñoz and Alonso Urrutia
content:
_This article by Alma E. Muñoz and Alonso Urrutia originally appeared in
the[July 23, 2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/07/23/politica/con-una-
fuerte-custodia-llego-a-palacio-nacional-jamieson-greer-el-representante-
comercial-de-eu), Mexico's premier left wing daily newspaper._

**Mexico City.** With progress on the USMCA review and bilateral agreements,
the meeting between President Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo and the United States
Trade Representative, Jamieson Greer, concluded.

> "At Palacio Nacional, we met with the United States Trade Representative,
> Jamieson Greer; we made progress on the USMCA review and bilateral
> agreements for the benefit of both peoples," President Sheinbaum posted on
> her social media.

It was nearly 90 minutes of conversation. The American and his delegation left
Palacio Nacional at 11:33 a.m.

Under heavy security, the United States Trade Representative, Jamieson Greer,
arrived at Palacio Nacional, accompanied, among others, by the Ambassador to
Mexico, Ronald Johnson, to meet with President Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo.

> En Palacio Nacional, nos reunimos con el representante comercial de Estados
> Unidos, Jamieson Greer; avanzamos en la revisión del T-MEC y acuerdos
> bilaterales en beneficio de ambos pueblos.
> [pic.twitter.com/eYUkcGu4SY](https://t.co/eYUkcGu4SY)
>
> -- Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo (@Claudiashein) [July 23,
> 2026](https://x.com/Claudiashein/status/2080362294442185197?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw)

Moments earlier, at the end of her press conference, the president anticipated
that it would be a broad meeting. "It's like an evaluation of how far we're
going, what they are proposing, even the timelines. So, to be able to have a
bit more information directly about how this review (of the USMCA) that we are
carrying out is being framed."
